content: It is essential to consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health needs. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to obtain a revised dosing schedule. Storage Instructions: Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and heat. Ensure the storage temperature does not exceed 104°F (40°C). Do not store this medication in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Dispose of this product properly when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific condition. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete guidance regarding this product and your individual health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To access formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer.
